data.name: Naqeeba
data.gender_notes: Naqeeba is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-q-b', meaning to lead or be in command. In Islamic history, Naqeeba can refer to a female leader or princess, embodying strength, wisdom, and righteousness. The name Naqeeba carries the meaning “Leader, Chief, Princess” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naqeeba usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, chief, princess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner leader, guiding the heart and soul towards righteousness and wisdom.
data.etymology: Naqeeba belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Leader, Chief, Princess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naqeeba total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: نقيبة
in_arabic.meaning: نقيبة تعني المرأة النقية والطيبة والمختارة
in_arabic.long_meaning: نقيبة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'نَقَبَ' الذي يعني البحث أو التنقيب. الاسم يحمل معاني النقاء والطهارة والاختيار. في بعض المراجع، يرتبط الاسم بمعنى القائدة أو الممثلة في مجموعة ما. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الفعل في القرآن الكريم، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة دينية وروحانية.

in_urdu.name: نقیبہ
in_urdu.meaning: نقیبہ یعنی پاکیزہ، نیک، اور منتخبہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نقیبہ ایک عربی اصل کا اسم علم مؤنث ہے، جو 'نَقَبَ' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے تلاش کرنا یا کھوجنا۔ یہ نام پاکیزگی، خیر، اور انتخاب کے معانی ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ بعض اوقات، یہ نام ایک قائد یا کسی گروہ کی نمائندہ کے معنی میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس فعل کی مشتقات قرآن مجید میں پائی جاتی ہیں، جو اس نام کو ایک خاص دینی اور روحانی اہمیت دیتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: नकीबा
in_hindi.meaning: नकीबा अर्थात् पवित्रा, नेक, और चुनी हुई
in_hindi.long_meaning: नकीबा एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो 'नकब' क्रिया से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है खोजना या ढूँढना। यह नाम पवित्रता, अच्छाई, और चयन के अर्थों को दर्शाता है। कभी-कभी, यह नाम एक नेता या समूह की प्रतिनिधि के अर्थ में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस क्रिया के व्युत्पन्न शब्द कुरआन में पाए जाते हैं, जो इस नाम को एक विशेष धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व प्रदान करते हैं।

in_english.name: Naqeeba
in_english.long_meaning: Naqeeba is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the verb 'naqaba', which means to search or dig. The name embodies meanings of purity, goodness, and being chosen. In some references, it is associated with the meaning of a leader or representative of a group. Derivatives of this verb appear in the Quran, lending the name religious and spiritual significance. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing desirable personality traits such as integrity and nobility.

data.cultural_impact: In historical contexts, Naqeeba can represent a powerful and influential woman, serving in noble positions such as a leader of a tribe or community. With her intelligence, diplomacy, and leadership skills, she could effectively manage her people's affairs, ensuring justice and peace prevailed within her domain. The cultural significance lies in her inspiring thousands of Muslim women throughout history and the present day to strive for excellence, independence, and influence in their personal and professional lives.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, the Islamic name Naqeeba can be seen as a reminder of Allah's divine guidance and the role of female leadership in upholding values like compassion, wisdom, and resilience. In the context of family and community life, a woman named Naqeeba can aspire to lead her loved ones in spiritually enriching ways, inspiring them toward disruption of ignorance and injustice while being a beacon of light and love in their lives. Simultaneously, the name can encourage self-reflection and personal growth leading to greater inner confidence, enabling her to share her talents, wisdom, and experiences as a responsible and compassionate servant of Allah.
